reading.body:
Baidu operates ERNIE, a family of Chinese foundation models that compete directly with Western large language models, positioning the company as a primary AI vendor within China's technology ecosystem.

The scale of Baidu's models reflects the compute intensity required to compete in foundation model development. ERNIE 5.0 contains 2.4 trillion parameters and integrates multiple modalities, text-to-image generation runs on an 8 billion parameter architecture, and document understanding models pursue benchmark-leading accuracy. These specifications indicate substantial infrastructure requirements for both training and inference.

Baidu's position as a publicly traded company with SEC filings means its AI operations exist within dual regulatory frameworks, Chinese and American. ERNIE products carry explicit cross-border data review warnings, signaling that users outside China should account for data handling practices in their deployment decisions. The company's web presence consolidates its AI work under a single domain, making ERNIE the public interface between Baidu's compute investments and end users.

This data does not cover Baidu's power consumption, data center locations, hardware choices, or compute allocation across products. It does not show how ERNIE compares to other Chinese or Western models in inference cost or training efficiency. It shows only that Baidu operates a major foundation model effort and where users can access its outputs.

profile_text.body:
Baidu is a Chinese technology company founded in 2000 and headquartered in Beijing. It is publicly traded under the ticker BIDU and operates as a for-profit public company. Its AI-facing web presence centers on the ERNIE platform at ernie.baidu.com, which serves as the home for its large model research and releases.

Baidu's primary AI product is ERNIE, a family of foundation models categorized as Chinese foundation models, with cross-border data review advised for users outside China. The company's site describes ERNIE 5.0 as a 2.4 trillion-parameter unified multimodal model trained from scratch, integrating text, image, video, and audio into a single autoregressive framework. A companion model, ERNIE-Image, is described as a text-to-image generation model built on a single-stream Diffusion Transformer architecture with 8 billion DiT parameters. The site also announces PaddleOCR-VL-1.5, an upgraded document understanding model the company describes as achieving a state-of-the-art accuracy of 94.5% on OmniDocBench v1.5.

Baidu holds an SEC filing under CIK 0001329099, consistent with its status as a publicly listed company. No litigation or MCP server records are present in the held facts.
